summary: This note is the table of contents for Part II (Imaging Neuroscience: Theory and Analysis) of the 2nd edition of Human Brain Function, with section editors J Ashburner, K Friston and W Penny. It lists 23 chapters grouped into four sections: Computational Neuroanatomy, Modeling, Inference, and Functional Integration, with authors for each chapter. It ends with a copyright notice restricting reposting without permission.
one_line: Table of contents for Part II of the 2nd edition of Human Brain Function, covering imaging neuroscience theory and analysis methods.
key_facts: Human Brain Function, 2nd Edition is the book from which this table of contents comes.
Section editors for the book are J Ashburner, K Friston and W Penny.
Part II is titled Imaging Neuroscience - Theory and Analysis.
Section 1, Computational Neuroanatomy, is edited by J Ashburner and covers chapters 2 to 6 on registration, normalization, warping, segmentation and morphometry.
Chapter 7 is The General Linear Model by S. Kiebel and A. Holmes.
Section 2, Modeling, is edited by W Penny and covers chapters 7 to 13, including Analysis of fMRI time series by R. Henson.
Chapter 11 is Hemodynamic modeling, with authors listed as K Friston, D. Glaser, A. Mechelli, R. Turner and C. Price.
Section 3, Inference, is edited by W Penny and covers chapters 14 to 17 on random field theory, nonparametric approaches and classical and Bayesian inference.
Chapter 15, Developments in Random Field Theory, is by K. Worsley.
Chapter 16, Nonparametric Approaches, is by T. Nichols and A. Holmes.
Section 4, Functional Integration, is edited by K Friston and covers chapters 18 to 22 on functional and effective connectivity, Volterra kernels and dynamical causal models.
Chapter 19, Functional Connectivity, is by K Friston and C Büchel.
Chapter 23 is the Mathematical Appendix by K Friston.
The copyright notice states that copyright is retained by authors or other copyright holders and that works may not be reposted without explicit permission.
